# Bad Casus Belli Examples
# Demonstrates CB-001 and CB-002

# ERROR CB-001: No outcome effects
bad_cb_001 = {
	# ERROR CB-001: No on_victory, on_defeat, or on_white_peace
	# Should have: on_victory = { scope:attacker = { add_prestige = 100 } }

	valid_to_start = {
		is_at_war = no
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = { is_alive = yes }
	}

	cost = {
		prestige = 100
	}

	war_score_from_battles_factor = 1.0
}

# ERROR CB-002: Unknown cost type
bad_cb_002 = {
	valid_to_start = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	cost = {
		honor = 100 # ERROR CB-002: 'honor' is not a valid cost type
		# Should have: prestige, piety, or gold
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}
}

# Multiple errors combined
bad_cb_all = {
	valid_to_start = {
		is_at_war = no
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = { is_alive = yes }
	}

	cost = {
		renown = 50 # ERROR CB-002: 'renown' is not a valid cost type
	}

	# ERROR CB-001: No on_victory, on_defeat, or on_white_peace

	war_score_from_battles_factor = 1.0
}

# Edge case: Only on_defeat defined (still has outcome)
bad_cb_only_defeat = {
	valid_to_start = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = -100
		}
	}

	# Not an error — on_defeat counts as an outcome effect
}

# Edge case: Multiple unknown cost types
bad_cb_multiple_unknown_costs = {
	valid_to_start = {
		is_at_war = no
	}

	cost = {
		honor = 50 # ERROR CB-002: 'honor' is not a valid cost type
		influence = 25 # ERROR CB-002: 'influence' is not a valid cost type
		gold = 100 # Valid cost type
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = 200
		}
	}
}

# Edge case: Empty outcome effects
bad_cb_empty_outcomes = {
	# ERROR CB-001: Empty outcome blocks count as no effects

	valid_to_start = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	on_victory = {
	}

	on_defeat = {
	}

	war_score_from_battles_factor = 0.5
}
